Thanks Aditya — the draft is helpful. A couple of notes from our side:
- We need the security/compliance column expanded: our InfoSec team will need evidence for data handling and key lifecycle (SOC2 artifacts and KMS details). Can your team attach the relevant docs?
- Procurement: looping in procurement to confirm PO cadence. We typically issue a PO ~3 weeks after SOW signoff (subject to vendor paperwork).
- Timeline: the 12-week estimate looks feasible but can we compress phase 1 (core integration) to 6–7 weeks if we run parallel tasks on our side?

Procurement contact: procurement@lakesidehealth.com (Samir Patel covers this engagement).

I'll review the MAP with the InfoSec team on Mon and send feedback by Tue close.

Best,

Nora — great questions. I updated the MAP with clearer gating for security and split owners into Product Integrations (Eng), CS Enablement, and Customer IT. See attached Lakeside_MAP_v2.xlsx and a short runbook draft. Key clarifications:

1) Phase definitions (condensed):
- Phase 0: Paperwork + security intake (2 weeks) — Owner: Aditya / Customer Procurement
- Phase 1: Core integration (6 weeks parallelizable) — Owner: Marissa (CS) / Lauren (Infra SME)
- Phase 2: Validation & pilot (2 weeks) — Owner: Customer IT + CS
- Phase 3: Production cutover & metrics handover (2 weeks) — Owner: CS Ops

2) Security artifacts: we will attach SOC2 summary, KMS integration checklist, network diagrams, and an endpoint data-flow document to the runbook.

3) Action items for kickoff (Thu 2028-10-13 10:00 PT):
- Confirm final owner list and PO target date
- Agree SLAs and acceptance criteria for pilot
- Identify a single billing contact for the SOW (Procurement typically handles PO, billing contact often comes from Finance)

Attachments: Lakeside_MAP_v2.xlsx; Activation_Runbook_v1.docx

Hi Aditya / Nora —

Samir Patel here. Typical cadence for contracts of this size is:
- SOW finalization: 1 week after vendor redlines are cleared
- Internal procurement approval: 5–10 business days after SOW final
- PO issuance: target 15 business days after SOW final (best case 10 days, worst case 21 days)

Billing contact: please put our AP team (ap@lakesidehealth.com) on the SOW; Finance will assign a named contact once the PO is in progress.

I'll join the kickoff and can provide an internal timeline once we see the final SOW.

Regards,

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Lakeside Health activation & MAP draft — agreed owners & gate checks

Thanks everyone — good discussion across the threads and the kickoff. Summarizing the agreed MAP, owners, and firm dates below for visibility and handoff:

Summary (finalized):
- Phase 0 (Paperwork & Security Intake): 2028-10-23 to 2028-11-03 — Owners: Aditya (Redwood AE) / Samir (Lakeside Procurement). Deliverables: signed SOW, PO window confirmed, security intake form complete.
- Phase 1 (Core integration): 2028-11-06 to 2028-12-15 — Owners: Marissa (CS) / Lauren (Infra SME). Deliverables: integration connectors live in staging, end-to-end smoke tests.
- Phase 2 (Validation & Pilot): 2028-12-18 to 2029-01-05 — Owners: Lakeside IT + CS. Deliverables: pilot cohort metrics, acceptance signoff.
- Phase 3 (Production Cutover & Handover): 2029-01-08 to 2029-01-19 — Owners: CS Ops. Deliverables: production monitoring, runbook handed to customer success and ops.

Escalation path:
- Day 0–3 blocker: On-call engineer (Lauren) -> Marissa -> Vivek
- SLA exceptions or contract items: Aditya -> Vivek (exec sponsor)

Open action items for the next 7 days:
1) Aditya: send final SOW draft with billing contact = ap@lakesidehealth.com (ETA: 2028-10-22).
2) Samir: confirm PO best/worst case window in writing (ETA: 2028-10-24).
3) Marissa: upload the runbook artifacts to the shared Drive and attach SOC2/KMS summary (ETA: 2028-10-24).
4) Lauren: prepare a staging test matrix and list of infra pre-reqs for Phase 1 (ETA: 2028-10-26).

Attachments to be shared: Lakeside_MAP_v2.xlsx, Activation_Runbook_v1.docx, SOW_Lakeside_v1.pdf (SOW will be updated with billing contact). Link to the working board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-4721

If there are no objections I'll convert this thread into a shared Drive folder and set the calendar invites. Appreciate the quick alignment — we aim to start Phase 0 on Monday 2028-10-23.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
